paite: I sanggamnu, Phoibi, Kenkriai khuaa saptuamte nasem,
english: I commend to you Phoebe, our sister, who is a servant or, deacon of the assembly that is at Cenchreae,

paite: Toupa mina misiangthoute banga nana kipahpihna ding uleh, na huh uh a kiphatmohna peuha na nahuh ding un honmel theihsak ka ut ahi. Amah mahin leng mi tampi a nahuha, kei ngei leng a honhuh jel ahi.
english: that you receive her in the Lord, in a way worthy of the saints, and that you assist her in whatever matter she may need from you, for she herself also has been a helper of many, and of my own self.

paite: Kris Jesu-a honpanpihte Prisila leh Akuila chibai honbuk sak un.
english: Greet Prisca and Aquila, my fellow workers in Christ Jesus,

paite: Amau ka hinna adingin amau ngawng a peta ua: amau tung kiaah kipahthu ka gen kei hi, ahihhangin Jentel saptuam tengteng tungah leng, ka gen sam hi.
english: who for my life, laid down their own necks; to whom not only I give thanks, but also all the assemblies of the Gentiles.

paite: A in ua saptuam kikhawmte leng chibai honbuk sak un aw. Ka deihtak, Epainita, Asia gama Kris gingta masapen, chibai honbuk sak un aw.
english: Greet the assembly that is in their house. Greet Epaenetus, my beloved, who is the first fruits of Achaia to Christ.

paite: Mari, nou dia semgim, chibai honbuk sak un aw.
english: Greet Mary, who labored much for us.

paite: Ka chipih leh ka hentak pih, Andronika leh Junia, chibai honbuk sak un; amau tuh sawltakte laka minthang tak ahi ua, kei sanga Krisa om masa jaw ahi uh.
english: Greet Andronicus and Junia, my relatives and my fellow prisoners, who are notable among the apostles, who also were in Christ before me.

paite: Ampliata, Toupa a ka deihtak, chibai honbuk sak un aw.
english: Greet Amplias, my beloved in the Lord.

paite: Kris a I naseppih uh Urbana leh ka deihtak Stakhi chibai honbuk sak un.
english: Greet Urbanus, our fellow worker in Christ, and Stachys, my beloved.

paite: Kris mi tak, Apelli, chibai honbuk sak un. Aristobula inkuanpihte laka mite chibai honbuk sak un.
english: Greet Apelles, the approved in Christ. Greet those who are of the household of Aristobulus.

paite: Ka chipih, Herodion, chibai honbuk sak un. Narkissa inkuanpihte laka mi, Toupaa om, chibai honbuk sak un.
english: Greet Herodion, my kinsman. Greet them of the household of Narcissus, who are in the Lord.

paite: Triphaina leh Triphosa Toupa a semgimte, chibai hon nabuk sak un aw. Deihtak Persi, Toupa a semgim mahmahsa chibai honna buk sak un.
english: Greet Tryphaena and Tryphosa, who labor in the Lord. Greet Persis, the beloved, who labored much in the Lord.

paite: Toupa a tel Rufa leh a nu, kei nu sam leng, chibai honna buk sak un.
english: Greet Rufus, the chosen in the Lord, and his mother and mine.

paite: Asinkaraita te, Phligon te, Herma te, Patroba te, Hermi te a kiang ua unau omte toh, chibai honna buk sak un aw.
english: Greet Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, Hermas, and the brothers The word for “brothers” here and where context allows may also be correctly translated “brothers and sisters” or “siblings.” who are with them.

paite: Philologa leh Julia, Neria leh sanggamnu, Olimpa leh, a kiang ua mi siangthou om tengteng, chibai honna buk sak un.
english: Greet Philologus and Julia, Nereus and his sister, and Olympas, and all the saints who are with them.

paite: Tawp siangthouin chibai kibuk un. Kris saptuam pawl tengtengin chibai hon buk chiat uhi.
english: Greet one another with a holy kiss. The assemblies of Christ greet you.

paite: Huan, unaute aw, thuhilhnathu noumau hilh louh lama kikhenna leh pukna siamte apan kiveng ding leh kiheisan dingin kon ngen ahi.
english: Now I beg you, brothers, look out for those who are causing the divisions and occasions of stumbling, contrary to the doctrine which you learned, and turn away from them.

paite: Huchibang miten i Toupa Kris na a sem kei ua, amau gilpi na a sem jaw uhi; a kam phat uleh a kam siam un mi pilloute lungsim a khem nak uhi.
english: For those who are such don’t serve our Lord, Jesus Christ, but their own belly; and by their smooth and flattering speech, they deceive the hearts of the innocent.

paite: Na omdan uh mi tengteng lakah a thangkheta ngala. Huaijiakin noumau tungthu ah ka kipak ahi; a hihhangin, hoih lamah na pil ua, gilou lamah na pil louh uh ka deih ahi.
english: For your obedience has become known to all. I rejoice therefore over you. But I desire to have you wise in that which is good, but innocent in that which is evil.

paite: Huan, lemna Pathianin na khepek nuai uah Setan a honsik den sak zok ding ahi. I Toupa Jesu Kris hehpihna na kiang uah om heh.
english: And the God of peace will quickly crush Satan under your feet. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.

paite: Ka naseppih Timothi leh ka chipih Lusia te, Jason te, Sosipater te khawngin chibai a honbuk uhi.
english: Timothy, my fellow worker, greets you, as do Lucius, Jason, and Sosipater, my relatives.

paite: Kei, Tertia, hiai lai gelhin, Toupa minin chibai ka honbuk ahi.
english: I, Tertius, who write the letter, greet you in the Lord.

paite: Ka tunnapa Gaia leh, saptuam tengteng in chibai a honbuk uhi. Huaia sum kempa Erata leh, unaupa Kuartain chibai a honbuk uhi.
english: Gaius, my host and host of the whole assembly, greets you. Erastus, the treasurer of the city, greets you, as does Quartus, the brother.

paite: I Toupa Jesu Kris hehpihna na vek ua kiangah om hen. Amen.
english: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all! Amen.

paite: Tuin, Amah, ka Tanchinhoih gen bang leh thuguk kilakna bangbanga Jesu Kris ka tangkoupih banga noute honhihhatthei-pa, -huai thuguk tuh tanglai sawtpi mahmah sung selguka na om himahleh.
english: TR places Romans 14:24-26 at the end of Romans instead of at the end of chapter 14, and numbers these verses 16:25-27.

paite: Tun bel ginna thumanna piangsak dingin jawlnei laibute zanga nam tengteng kianga theihsak leh tangtawn Pathian thupiak bangin taklatin a hongomta hiPilna Pathian kiang kia ah, Jesu Kris jiaka, thupina tangtawn dongin om hen! Amen.
Pilna Pathian kiang kia ah, Jesu Kris jiaka, thupina tangtawn dongin om hen! Amen.
